blockingFindings.title: R14 migration parity lacks coverage for finalize leaf approval behavior and state promotion
blockingFindings.issue: R14 requires migration parity for finalize leaf order and approval behavior, flow state promotion, retry metrics, plugin hooks, and side effects. The current tests cover finalize-commit approval and some lifecycle side effects, but they do not cover approval behavior for the finalize leaves whose behavior is explicitly called out, nor do they verify saved flow-state promotion across the acceptance-review to final-regression/finalize path beyond a next-action read.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add the smallest spec-local assertion that exercises the persisted flow transition after acceptance-review pass and verifies the finalize leaf approval behavior expected by the existing public contract.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R14 is a must requirement and the coverage artifact marks it covered, but part of the required migration parity contract has no corresponding executable spec-local coverage.

advisoryFindings.title: Temporary directory cleanup pattern is fragile inside looped tests
advisoryFindings.improvement: Prefer creating a fresh local tmp variable inside each loop iteration or resetting tmp in a finally block so a mid-loop assertion failure does not leave afterEach pointing at an already-removed or stale directory.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: This is a test hygiene issue, not a missing acceptance requirement or an anti-pattern that would make the tests pass without production behavior.
